item.coloph: bdag 'dra li shu stag ring gyis/ man ngag rgyas 'bring shin tu bsdus pa rnams/ gang zag rigs dang bstun nas byas pa yin/ gtso cher gsang sngags 'di la mos pa la/ g.yung drung spyod pa'i 'phreng ba'i thabs mchog 'di/ 'phring chags (breng chags) mu tig star la brgyus pa bzhin/ ting 'dzin go rim nyams su blangs pa'i thabs/ 'di don nyams su longs la spyod lam gyis/ thun mong dag dang thun mong ma yin pa/ dngos grub dam pa 'di'i thob par nges/ ces tha ram rgyas btab nas/ rgyal blon gyi phyag tu gtad do//
